_comment: Import into Pterodactyl 1.x. Created for AzuRaya Control.
name: AzuRaya Managed Bot
author: azurifydigitalsolutions@gmail.com
description: Isolated AzuRaya instance with dashboard pairing callbacks.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y curl python3 ca-certificates
cd /mnt/server
curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 120 --retry 2 "$BOT_DOWNLOAD_URL" -o /tmp/bot.zip
python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile,pathlib,json,os
root=pathlib.Path('/mnt/server')
with zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/bot.zip') as z:
 files=[i for i in z.infolist() if not i.is_dir()]
 if sum(i.file_size for i in files)>200*1024*1024:raise Exception('Expanded archive exceeds 200 MB')
 prefixes={i.filename.split('/')[0] for i in files}
 strip=len(prefixes)==1 and not any(i.filename=='package.json' for i in files)
 for i in files:
  name=i.filename.split('/',1)[1] if strip else i.filename
  p=pathlib.PurePosixPath(name)
  if '\\' in name or p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts or not p.parts:raise Exception('Unsafe ZIP path')
  if p.parts[0] in ('session','node_modules','.git') or p.name.startswith('.env') or p.name=='cookies.txt':continue
  target=root.joinpath(*p.parts)
  target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  target.write_bytes(z.read(i))
if not (root/'start-panel.cjs').exists():raise Exception('Missing start-panel.cjs: use a compatible AzuRaya release')
(root/'data').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(root/'data/owner.json').write_text(json.dumps([os.environ['WHATSAPP_NUMBER']]))
(root/'session').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p=root/'package.json'
pkg=json.loads(p.read_text())
pkg['allowScripts']={**pkg.get('allowScripts',{}),'sharp':True,'ffmpeg-static':True,'@whiskeysockets/baileys':True,'protobufjs':True,'es5-ext':True}
p.write_text(json.dumps(pkg,indent=2))
PY
curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 120 --retry 2 "$BRIDGE_URL" -o dashboard-bridge.cjs
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
